signature: One long blinding-white hallway with branches to sixteen large rooms: eight Detox Zones (sunken, green-taped, ringed by the M.E.G. Ward) that heal fast but burn, and eight rooms of medical supplies and equipment; in the seeded Decay (Dead Zone) state black pits swallow the floor, walls buckle, blood dries brown and the Detox Zones tear flesh instead of healing it.

exits.method: No-clip into either end of the main hallway
exits.source_quote: One may return to Level 1 by no-clipping into either end of the main hallway.
exits.label: No-clipped through the end of the main hallway back to Level 1
exits.hint: Both ends of the main hallway are blank white walls; push into one.

notes: SOURCE: roughly one square mile of white rooms and corridors floored with smooth, almost soft tile; surfaces cannot be sullied and regenerate; one lengthy hallway with branches left and right to sixteen large rooms holding medical supplies/equipment or an empty Detox Zone; Detox Zones heal bones, wounds, fevers and poisoning fast but painfully (burning, sharp pain), not congenital illness; the M.E.G. Ward in all eight zones, M.E.G. manages entry; return to Level 1 by no-clipping into either end of the main hallway. Decay documents (testimony): reclassified Dead Zone, black pits that swallow fishing line, white walls bending into spots of pure blackness, rancid humid air, dried brown blood, green tape at a Detox Zone that is mostly abyss, healing that bubbles and tears the skin. ADAPTATION: the hallway is 204 m long (page: one square mile) with eight branch pairs streamed in 24 m chunks; rooms are 16 x 18 x 5.4 m; room types are seeded (8 Detox Zones, 3 supply stores, 2 surgeries, admissions, staff quarters, pharmacy; one Detox Zone always in the first pair); Detox Zones are sunken three risers and ringed with Ward beds; supply stores and surgeries have a +2.7 m steel mezzanine; the M.E.G. checkpoint at the south end; the Decay state is a seeded flag (about one seed in three; dossier: 'second variant (seeded flag)'), and the QA self-test and stills switch both states; heal 7 HP/s (White), Decay zone heals 1.6 s then deals 6 HP/s rising by 4 HP/s each second; falling into a pit is fatal; damaged tile in the White state fades over ~20 s when you are near; the arrival from Level 1 stands 3 m inside the south end wall facing down the hallway. Not built: The Ward's doctors as NPCs, corpses, Level 1.2 / Level 1.4 (link targets only).
entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. The M.E.G. Ward staff, Dr. Reathe, the scout and the Director appear only in the documents; nobody is spawned.
